utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — I heard the club dues are still due this week. Do you want to split the reminder around the block?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, that works for me. Let’s keep it simple and remind folks this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll mention it when I’m out this afternoon, and we can keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I skimmed the dues info—just tell me the amount and when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s $25, due by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — $25 by Friday, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the club dues are due this month, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so—but I’d want to double-check the exact deadline so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s double-check it then. I’d rather confirm the deadline before paying.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the club dues. I’m sorry, I think I misplaced the reminder, but I’m happy to pay up now if you tell me where to send it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Oren — you can hand it to me here, or I can point you to the treasurer if you’d rather send it there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll hand it to you here, that’s easiest. Sorry again for the mix-up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact amount and when it’s due? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure on the exact amount right this second, but I can check and get back to you about when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—please let me know the exact amount and due date when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — am I still good to pay the club dues now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, you’re still good to pay now — no worries at all.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll pay it now — thanks Jules.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what do you need to know about the dues?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just checking how much the club dues are and when they’re due.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: They’re $20 for the month, and I can take them by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check that for you—do you mean the dues for the club on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that’s the one—could you tell me the amount and when it’s due?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can look that up for you, but I don’t have the amount or due date on hand right now. If you want, I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Quinn — I heard the club dues are due pretty soon, and I can ask around if you’re not sure about the amount.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. If you hear the amount, let me know and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the amount. Thanks, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, have you figured out the club dues yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still checking the amount and when it’s due.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you let me know as soon as you find the amount and due date?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the club meeting and make sure we sort out the dues.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. Let me know what they decide.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll bring it up at the meeting and let you know what they decide.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m just checking in about the club membership dues—have you had a chance to take care of them yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, not yet—I’m a bit behind right now, but I haven’t forgotten. I’ll sort it out as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate you letting me know. Just keep me posted when you’ve sorted it out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Eli — I heard the club dues are due pretty soon, and I’m trying to figure out the best way to pay mine. Have you heard anything new about it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard anything new yet, Tess, but I’d just check the club notice or ask the front desk. I like to keep it simple and pay it the same way each year.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Eli — I’ll check the notice or swing by the front desk. I just want to make sure I don’t miss the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — are we talking about the club dues for this month?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, that’s the one — I’m just repeating the plan so everyone’s on the same page. We’re sorting out this month’s club dues now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can chip in now if you’re collecting, or just tell me the amount and deadline.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh—right, the club dues. How much are we looking at this month?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s $20 this month. I can cover it today if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot, thanks. I can pay you back soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, got it — what’s the dues amount and when do you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s $20, and I’d like it by Friday if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, $20 by Friday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I can help sort out the club dues—what’s the current amount and who still needs to pay?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I want to make sure I get this right before I say anything. I don’t have the current dues amount or the list of who still owes yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — I’ll check with the treasurer and get back to you with the exact amount and who still needs to pay.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the club dues. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can check what I owe and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — no rush, just let me know when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll look it up and let you know as soon as I’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard the dues went up a bit this season. I’m gonna check the details before I renew.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Ira — if you want, I can lend you my calculator or help you sort through the numbers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. I’ll swing by later after errands and we can figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — what do you need to know about the dues?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What’s the monthly amount, and when is it due?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s $20 a month, and it’s due by the 5th of each month.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing—when do you need the dues by, and how should I pay them?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We need them by Friday, and cash or bank transfer is fine.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, Friday works—I’ll make sure to get it to you by then. Cash is probably easiest for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, yes—if you’re thinking of joining, I can send you the dues details and the signup info right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—please send the dues details and signup info when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send over the dues details and signup info right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check our school schedule and see when I can get the dues taken care of.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye—that’d be a big help. Just let me know what works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll look at the calendar tonight and get back to you with a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I can help with the club dues—what’s easiest for you: paying today or setting up a time this week?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—setting up a time this week would be easiest for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course—what day and time this week works best for you?
